description: Read ERP records and review permission-checked business changes in 1XA ERP.

interface.longDescription: Connect your authorized 1XA ERP workspace to ChatGPT to read current ERP information and prepare business changes using the same permissions as the native ERP assistant. Supported areas include catalog and website listings, customers and addresses, purchasing, orders and fulfillment, receiving, returns, warehouse operations, and operational summaries. Every write produces a proposal for review in signed-in ERP. Confirm the exact change there; required physical-operation attestations remain explicit. Check the saved ERP receipt before treating an action as complete. Current company, role, record versions and access policy are checked again before execution. Uncertain outcomes are not automatically retried. Existing summary-only and product-review connections retain their current access until separate business consent is granted. This integration cannot bypass ERP permissions, change access roles, run arbitrary SQL or HTTP requests, or execute financial transactions.

publication.release_notes: Adds explicit ERP business consent for native assistant reads and reviewed actions, with current permissions, record checks, confirmation, and saved outcome receipts.
